## Strictness delta

Samples where APKAXIOM strict-rejects but AOSP-runtime accepts indicate
AOSP-runtime leniency that our strict validator catches. The CVE
families in this category (per badpack-cves/cve-mapping.json) are the
security-relevant rows: APKAXIOM blocks attacks that would slip past
AOSP's structural validation alone.

Specifically: AOSP's runtime accepts (but APKAXIOM rejects) the
filename-mismatch (BadPack-MasterKey, CVE-2013-4787),
field-mismatch (BadPack, CVE-2023-31346), and DD-violation
(APPNOTE.TXT §4.4.4) families because the runtime trusts the
central directory unilaterally and never re-reads the LFH for
consistency. Our  probe (struct-level + cross-record)
is strictly stricter.
